items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: And when I saw Cozy again, I think he was with Cab Calloway.

ctx.x: Well, how did these guys impress you at the time, people like Cozy and Chick Webb? Cozy seems to have been a very serious individual about drums and drumming. He was always studying. Was he that way when you first met him?

Yes... Cozy Cole, well, he know more about drums, and he could play. He's got that name, Cozy Cole. When I first met him, he was playing a dime-a-dance on 125th Street; a dance school, a dance hall on 125th Street. He had a five-piece band down there. I went down there... Of course, you couldn't do no settling down there, because that's a dime a dance, and they're playing two... They play about two choruses, and you'd hit on the woodblock, and that's when the girl would take a tip. And when I saw Cozy again, I…
No, unless it was later. But he did at least record with...
